is_anopheles.evidence: Studies field collections of Anopheles gambiae s.l. and Anopheles funestus in Angola (Page 1, Abstract; Page 2).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Assessed West African kdr (Vgsc L995F / kdr-west) in An. gambiae using the PCR protocol of Martinez-Torres et al. 1998 (Page 3, Methods).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 3 on Page 4 details sample sizes and kdr genotypes for 218 An. gambiae s.s. (195 M-form, 23 S-form) across 5 sites; all were homozygous susceptible (+/+).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were sampled by indoor pyrethrum spray collections and larval collections in seven localities in Angola (Luanda, Benguela, Lobito, Huambo) in April 2001 (Page 2).

is_primary_study.evidence: Primary empirical field research report describing species composition, sporozoite rates, and kdr genotype frequencies.

sub_country_location.evidence: Coordinates and specific site names provided for seven localities (e.g., Funda: 08°51' S, 13° 34' E; São Pedro: 12° 20' S, 13° 34' E; Cawango: 12° 34' S, 13° 24' E; São Jose: 12° 47' S, 15° 44' E) on Page 2.

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Sampling took place between 11 and 19 April 2001 (Page 2).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Routine primary field survey conducted in 2001 in Angola.

supplement.evidence: All site coordinates, sample sizes, molecular form distributions, and kdr genotype data are provided in the main text and tables (Tables 1-4).

assessment.summary: This primary study examined malaria vector species composition, molecular forms, Plasmodium falciparum sporozoite rates, and kdr resistance status in Angola. Mosquitoes were collected in April 2001 across seven localities. A total of 218 An. gambiae s.s. (195 M-form and 23 S-form) were genotyped for the West African kdr-west (Vgsc L995F) mutation. All genotyped mosquitoes were homozygous susceptible (+/+). No bioassays were conducted.
